`final class TweenManager`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.animation.tween` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TweenManager.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/animation/tween/TweenManager.java)

Holds tweens and timelines and advances them together when you update it.

## Description

Use one when code of yours already runs at each frame, for example `UI.update()`: call `update(...)` there with the time elapsed since the previous frame, in ms.
A [`TweenAnimator`](/reference/animation/tweenanimator/) needs no manager.
Its methods can be called from several threads.

- [Animation](/use/learn/style-and-motion/animation/)
